analysis: MERGE_CHECKS item 2: nuisance design, version 2 with marginalization
status: DESIGN FROZEN AND NOT RELEASED; blocked on the citation gate and the phantom scattering decision
what_version_1_got_wrong: it swept nuisance values and recomputed the six-parameter bound at each one, which treats the nuisance as KNOWN inside every draw. That answers conditional sensitivity, how the conclusion moves across plausible operating points, and not the reviewer's question, which is what the method is worth when thickness and scattering are unknown. The corrected design answers it with the nuisance-marginalized effective information.

augmented_parameterization.coordinates: log for every strictly positive quantity, additive for the scattering exponent shift. Positivity is then automatic for any finite eta, so no draw is ever rejected, and eta is dimensionless so its column scale is unity by construction.
augmented_parameterization.feasible_by_construction: boundaries strictly increasing and scattering strictly positive for every draw, verified over the whole set and at an absurd eta of plus and minus 6

marginalization.F_eff: F_pp - F_pe pinv(F_ee) F_ep, the Schur complement of the block Fisher matrix
marginalization.two_routes: Schur and projection; the projection route J_perp = (I - P_eta) J_w_psi is reported because it avoids a pseudo-inverse of a near-singular F_ee, and the Schur route is kept as evidence
verified_analytically: nuisance columns spanning one psi direction collapse to rank 1 and marginalization removes exactly that direction, |cos| 1.000000000000
nuisance orthogonal to psi costs no information, below 1e-12
F_eff is never larger than F_pp in the positive-semidefinite order, so marginalized bounds are never tighter than conditional ones
a rank-deficient F_ee is reported and still leaves psi identifiable, because marginalization removes only the identifiable part of the nuisance span
a psi direction lying inside the nuisance span makes F_eff rank deficient, no finite bound is reported, and the lost direction is identified as the one the nuisance swallowed
reports: rank, condition number and singularity of F_ee
rank of the nuisance column space
the change marginalization makes to StO2_U, StO2_D and the near-null direction

estimator_column_support.pmc_supports: the seven absorption columns, because the replay kernel accumulates pathlength and the escaping weight is w0 exp(-sum_j mua_j L_j), so pathlength moments give absorption derivatives and nothing else
estimator_column_support.consequence: the replay kernel must not be assumed to support geometry derivatives. For those five columns AD is compared against the ensemble central difference, the only estimator-independent reference available for them.

feasibility_gate.why_geometry_columns_are_suspect: a boundary position enters through a searchsorted layer index and through the distance-to-interface comparison, discrete branches that MOVE with the parameter. The pathwise derivative drops the boundary term they generate, which is the same mechanism that makes common-random-number finite differences unable to validate pathwise AD. A thickness derivative taken by AD is suspect by construction and must be demonstrated.
feasibility_gate.cost_consequence: a column that fails must be built by the ensemble central difference, which costs far more per draw, so the 48-draw cost cannot be fixed before the gate

cost.status: deferred until the gate reports per-column cost and noise
cost.lower_bound_basis: 48 draws at 372 s for forward plus the twelve-column jacfwd scaled from the six-column measurement, plus 164 s for the pMC replay. The jacfwd cost will rise with twelve columns rather than six and the gate measures that too.
cost.upper_bound: set by how many of the five pMC-unsupported columns need an ensemble central difference

citation_gate.log_d_papillary_problem: the cited source supplies the nominal layer thickness, not a measured spread. The 0.25 is currently carried over from the epidermal dimension by analogy, which is not an argument. A histological or imaging source for between-subject variation is required.
citation_gate.log_d_reticular_problem: the citation is an optical properties review, which is the wrong kind of source for a thickness width. A dedicated morphometric source is required, and it must support a width wider than the superficial dimensions rather than merely be consistent with it.
citation_gate.rule: no transport may be submitted while this gate is closed

phantom_scattering.mandatory_label: not re-evaluated under the nuisance prior
phantom_scattering.why: a Fisher statement about a nuisance column and an empirical recovery failure on measured phantom data are different claims on different data

classification_groups.conditional: supplementary; from F_pp with eta held at the drawn value
classification_groups.marginalized: primary; from F_eff. This group answers the reviewer.
classification_groups.new_marginalized_classification: marginalized_upper_StO2_well_conditioned is flagged in the spec as the one most likely to fail, because the upper plexus conclusion is the one the manuscript relies on and the nuisance lies on the path to it

melanin_decision.choice: included in eta as a jointly unknown nuisance
melanin_decision.not_an_equity_claim: marginalizing over an unknown nuisance is a statement about surviving information, not about differences between people. No stratification, no ratio, no tone statement.
melanin_decision.override: demote to a conditional sensitivity dimension if the user prefers

scope_decisions_confirmed.melanin: log_f_melanin stays in eta as a jointly unknown nuisance absorber; tone stratification, population ratios and equity claims remain forbidden
scope_decisions_confirmed.phantom_scattering: separated from this round; the P1 and P2 measured-phantom recovery result stays in section 3.4 labelled 'not re-evaluated under the nuisance prior'; this round may report only 'scattering nuisance remains weakly constrained'; no new phantom recovery is run

A_nuisance_side_marginalization.what_was_missing: only F_psi_eff was computed, so a claim about the scattering nuisance would have been read from bare F_ee, which assumes psi is KNOWN. That is the assumption this check exists to remove.
A_nuisance_side_marginalization.added: F_eta_eff = F_ee - F_ep pinv(F_pp) F_pe, by the projection route J_eta_perp = (I - P_psi) J_eta with the Schur form as cross-check only
A_nuisance_side_marginalization.scattering_classification_now_uses: the data-only estimable bound on log_mus_scale from F_eta_eff, never bare F_ee
A_nuisance_side_marginalization.demonstration: in a constructed case where the log_mus_scale column lies inside the psi column span, bare F_ee gives it a sqrt-CRLB of 0.0248, well inside its 0.20 prior so it would read as measured, while F_eta_eff shows it not individually estimable at all with a null-space leakage of 1.000000

prior_informed_posterior.why: the prior precision is positive definite, so the posterior is finite even where the data alone identify nothing. In the same constructed case log_mus_scale has no data-only bound yet a posterior/prior SD ratio of exactly 1.000000, which says the data narrowed nothing. Reporting the two under one name would let a prior masquerade as a measurement.
invariants_verified: with zero information the posterior equals the prior exactly

B_per_parameter_estimability.what_was_wrong: every bound was set to None whenever an information matrix lost rank, which erases the bound of a parameter that is still identifiable because some other direction is not
B_per_parameter_estimability.rule: from the SVD take a null-space basis N; parameter j is individually estimable when ||N^T e_j|| is below the recorded leakage tolerance of 1e-08, and then a finite e_j^T F^+ e_j is reported; otherwise the bound is 'infinite', the value is null, and the leakage is recorded
B_per_parameter_estimability.nullity_above_one: no single near-null vector and no dominant component are reported, because any one eigenvector the solver returns is a basis artifact. The null space is reported as a dimension and a basis, and estimator comparisons use principal angles and the projector distance.
B_per_parameter_estimability.single_direction_only_when: full rank AND the smallest eigenvalue separated from the next by the declared ratio of 10
analytic_cases_verified: F = diag(1, 0): the first parameter finite at 1.0, the second infinite with leakage 1.0
a 30 degree rotated single null direction: both parameters inestimable with leakages 0.5 and 0.8660, decided by their own projections
diag(2, 0, 3): the two identifiable parameters keep finite bounds while the third is infinite
a two-dimensional null space: a single direction is refused, the subspace is reported, and dominant_component is absent
full rank with eigenvalue separation 1.010 is refused and 100 is accepted
principal angles and projector distance: 0 for identical subspaces, 1.000 for orthogonal ones
